# OneUp

OneUp is a social media management platform for scheduling and managing posts, comments, connected accounts, media, and analytics across multiple social networks.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/oneup/.

## Actions

- **Comment On Post**: Publish a new top-level comment on a social post through a connected OneUp social account.
- **Create Image Post**: Create a scheduled, timeslot, or draft image post for selected OneUp social accounts.
- **Create Media Upload URL**: Create a temporary OneUp media upload URL and return instructions for a separate direct upload.
- **Create Text Post**: Create a scheduled, timeslot, or draft text post for selected OneUp social accounts.
- **Create Video Post**: Create a scheduled, timeslot, or draft video post for selected OneUp social accounts.
- **Delete Comment**: Permanently and irreversibly delete a social-platform comment and its local OneUp record.
- **Delete Scheduled Post**: Permanently and irreversibly delete an unpublished scheduled OneUp post.
- **Edit Scheduled Post**: Replace the content and optionally the title of a scheduled OneUp post.
- **Get Analytics Overview** (read-only): Get account-level overview metrics and ranked performance for a connected account on a supported social platform.
- **Get Audience Demographics** (read-only): Get audience demographics for a connected Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube account for a preset or custom reporting period.
- **Get Content Analytics** (read-only): Get per-post, Reel, or Story analytics for a connected account on a supported social platform.
- **Get Google Business Reviews** (read-only): Get Google Business Profile reviews and aggregate rating information for a connected account or location.
- **Get Meta Ads Analytics** (read-only): Get campaign, ad-set, or individual-ad analytics for a connected Meta Ads account.
- **List Categories** (read-only): List OneUp categories used to group connected social accounts.
- **List Category Accounts** (read-only): List social accounts assigned to a OneUp category.
- **List Comment Replies** (read-only): Fetch child replies for a parent social-platform comment.
- **List Comment Threads** (read-only): List social posts with top-level comments and child replies in the requested order, one page at a time.
- **List Instagram Trending Sounds** (read-only): Search Instagram trending sounds for a Facebook-connected Instagram Business or Creator account.
- **List Pinterest Boards** (read-only): List boards available to a connected Pinterest username for post targeting.
- **List Posts** (read-only): List scheduled, published, or failed OneUp posts, one page at a time.
- **List Social Accounts** (read-only): List all connected OneUp social accounts and their connection health.
- **List TikTok Trending Sounds** (read-only): Get TikTok trending commercial sounds for a documented country, period, genre, and connected TikTok account.
- **List YouTube Playlists** (read-only): List playlists for a connected YouTube channel.
- **Refresh Analytics**: Start a background refresh of analytics for all connected social accounts.
- **Refresh Comments**: Start a background refresh of comments from connected social platforms.
- **Reply To Comment**: Publish a direct reply to an existing social-platform comment.
- **Reschedule Failed Post**: Move a failed post back into the schedule at a future date and time.
